meta.title: LFI Pipeline — Phase 2 LangGraph Workflow (Examination Meeting)

cards.title: New: sufficiency-check gate (fixes Critical Finding #3)
items: current_state.png's Phase 2 shows an iterative sufficiency loop earlier drafts left unmodeled — this gate makes it a real, human-judged state, not an assumed one-shot extraction

"Insufficient" re-enters Phase 1's Intake Tracker via Intake Tracker's round_submitted(round: N+1) event, not all_submitted — that trigger is Gap Analysis's specifically and must not re-fire on further-submission rounds (fixes audit 2.7; no literal loop-back edge drawn, to avoid clutter)
Updated (decision 99): "requests → sufficiency" isn't direct — Lead/Approver review, LFI relay, and round-2 intake happen first; full sequence in lfi-further-submission-review-sequence-v1.html

cards.title: Guardrail
items: Sufficiency Check is explicitly human-judged (ADR-0003 augmentation principle) — no LLM auto-resolution of "resolved", since that was previously undefined

cards.title: How to read this diagram
items: Branch points (e.g. Sufficiency Check's sufficient/insufficient split) are edge-labeled, not drawn as decision diamonds — archify's workflow grammar has no decision-node/fork-join primitive, so guard conditions live on the edge label, not a gateway shape
Closest standard: a UML activity diagram without gateway notation. Human checkpoints use a dedicated lane, not a person-icon convention
